svg.aria-label: Success under injected failures, teacher / DP zoom / DP robust DAgger: No perturbation 100, 76, 74; Missed grasp 98, 51, 54; Cube dropped 90, 12, 38; Cube knocked 84, 49, 56; Pushed in hand 100, 81, 75; Arm shoved 100, 76, 75; Late knock 90, 37, 43. The last three perturbations were never seen in training.
